claim_boundary: Every historical interval, the original 105 trials, the Generation 4 and 5 outcomes, and the literature themes used to construct these formulas were already seen. Hash freezing and the official-run claim document this runner's process but cannot create a pristine holdout or cryptographically prove that no alternate local script previewed the readable panel. A pass is only a retrospective paper-challenger result; it cannot establish future profitability, independent alpha, exact options P&L, permission for live capital, or financial superiority over unreproducible competitor systems.

faber_gtaa5_trend.mechanism: Five fixed 20% SPY/EFA/IEF/VNQ/DBC slots; each slot is invested only above its inclusive SMA210 and otherwise remains in BIL.

source_pins.title: A Quantitative Approach to Tactical Asset Allocation

g6_trend_guard_g4.mechanism: Apply an inclusive SMA210 gate independently to the frozen G4 allocation's 50% QQQ sleeve and three fixed one-sixth 12-minus-6 sector sleeves; failed slots remain in BIL.

source_pins.title: A Quantitative Approach to Tactical Asset Allocation

g6_vol_target_g4.mechanism: Scale the frozen G4 risky target by min(1, 10% divided by its static-target annualized volatility over the latest 22 daily returns); hold the residual in BIL.

g6_breadth_scaled_g4.mechanism: Scale every frozen G4 risky sleeve by the fraction of the original nine sectors with positive 21-session excess log return over BIL; hold the residual in BIL.

source_pins.title: Herding for profits: Market breadth and the cross-section of global equity returns
source_pins.authors: Adam Zaremba, Adam Szyszka, Andreas Karathanasopoulos, Mateusz Mikutowski

g6_residual_sector.mechanism: Fit each sector's SPY-minus-BIL and QQQ-minus-SPY betas with an intercept over the t-756..t-21 price-endpoint window; rank t-252..t-21 factor-stripped return sum divided by sample deviation without subtracting the intercept, then hold 50% SPY plus fixed one-sixth slots for up to three positive sectors.

source_pins.title: Residual Momentum
source_pins.authors: David Blitz, Joop Huij, Martin Martens

g6_long_only_tsmom_1_3_12.mechanism: For each 21/63/252-session horizon, inverse-EWMA-volatility weight cross-asset ETFs with positive BIL-excess log return; average the three fully funded sleeves equally and leave empty sleeves in BIL.

source_pins.title: Time Series Momentum
source_pins.authors: Tobias J. Moskowitz, Yao Hua Ooi, Lasse Heje Pedersen

source_pins.title: Time series momentum and volatility scaling
source_pins.authors: Abby Y. Kim, Yiuman Tse, John K. Wald

g6_hrp_trend.mechanism: Admit cross-asset ETFs only with positive 252-session BIL-excess momentum and price above inclusive SMA210, then allocate with deterministic single-linkage hierarchical risk parity from a 252-session covariance matrix.

source_pins.title: Building Diversified Portfolios that Outperform Out of Sample

g6_equal_evidence_ensemble.mechanism: Equal 25% weight-vector blend of the trend-guard, residual-sector, 1/3/12 TSMOM, and HRP-trend candidates; before residual history is available, that quarter remains entirely in BIL.

source_pins.title: Optimal Versus Naive Diversification: How Inefficient is the 1/N Portfolio Strategy?
source_pins.authors: Victor DeMiguel, Lorenzo Garlappi, Raman Uppal

primary_spy_track.objective: Among candidates that pass every frozen SPY economic and safety gate, maximize the smaller development/validation annualized log-growth edge versus SPY.
tie_breaks: larger minimum development/validation cash-excess Sharpe difference versus SPY

growth_control_challenge_track.objective: Separately challenge QQQ and two static growth controls without making their higher-risk exposures a prerequisite for the primary SPY-improvement track.
tie_breaks: larger minimum development/validation cash-excess Sharpe difference versus SPY

selection.objective: Among candidates that pass every frozen SPY economic and safety gate, maximize the smaller development/validation annualized log-growth edge versus SPY.
tie_breaks: larger minimum development/validation cash-excess Sharpe difference versus SPY
selection.recent_data_use: Recent data can veto but never rank, rescue, or break a tie.

spy_buy_hold.construction: Every overlapping window is independently rebased from BIL, charges a fresh 5 bp entry per absolute traded notional, removes any inherited full-sample terminal liquidation, and charges its own terminal liquidation.
spy_buy_hold.inference_boundary: Overlapping windows are autocorrelated descriptive evidence, not independent trials or p-values.

causal_four_regime_evidence.classification: Before each scored return, compare compounded SPY and BIL returns over the prior 252 sessions and annualize SPY volatility over the prior 63; volatility strictly above 20% is high.
causal_four_regime_evidence.causality: The current scored return is excluded from both regime signals. Regimes are descriptive and were specified after history was seen.

concentration.boundary: HHI and effective-position counts condition on non-cash gross and do not look through ETF holdings; direct QQQ plus XLK is not a technology look-through exposure.

recurring_300_per_month.purpose: Small-account fractional-ETF evidence only; this is not an options-P&L simulation.

spy_buy_hold.contribution_timing: Gross deposit at the start of the first modeled return interval in each calendar month.
spy_buy_hold.cost_model: Fresh-account entry uses the engine's full L1 turnover convention; later deposits pay one-way cost on non-BIL purchases; paths end mark-to-market without liquidation.
spy_buy_hold.implementation_boundary: Fractional ETF units; percentage-return paths remain the frozen causal ledgers; overlapping windows are descriptive and not independent probability estimates.
